requirement: Safely lay out and edit left/right captions on HWPX inline pictures, and preserve rendered placement through T009 save and independent reopen.

implementation.scope: Embedded plain HWPX body pictures with treatAsChar=true, zero rotation/flips and outer margins, captionIncludeMargin=false, positive caption width and bounded nonnegative spacing. The inline flow box reserves the caption width and gap; the image and caption use the stored Left/Right side and Top/Center/Bottom vertical alignment.
implementation.refused: Rotated or flipped inline pictures, included caption margins, nonzero outer margins, external/non-plain pictures, missing or ambiguous caption ownership/number slot, and unproved paragraph formatting do not expose lateral edit operations.
